title: Closed constant coefficient tensors and pullback on the etale site
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Work with constant ring sheaves $A_T$ and ordinary module sheaves on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For a closed immersion $i:C\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] set $P_C=i_*A_C$, with underived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], in degree zero. For every scheme morphism $v:X'\to X$, put $C'=X'\times_XC$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Pullback of locally constant sections on $C\times_XT$, for each etale $T\to X$, defines $P_C\to v_*P_{C'}$. Its adjoint, for the constant-ring inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], is an isomorphism
$$b_{v,C}:v^{-1}P_C\xrightarrow{\sim}P_{C'}.$$
It carries the restriction $A_X\to P_C$ to $A_{X'}\to P_{C'}$. These particular isomorphisms preserve identities and compositions under the canonical composition isomorphism for inverse images.

For closed immersions $C,D\hookrightarrow X$, put $I=C\times_XD$. Restrict locally constant sections on $C\times_XT$ and $D\times_XT$ to $I\times_XT$ and multiply. This gives an isomorphism of sheaf tensors [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]
$$\mu_{C,D}:P_C\otimes_{A_X}P_D\xrightarrow{\sim}P_I.$$
Every $P_C$ is flat, meaning that tensoring with it is an exact functor [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Consequently the same map on degree-zero flat models gives $\mu_{C,D}:P_C\otimes_A^LP_D\xrightarrow{\sim}P_I$ in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with total tensor as in [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Under the canonical associators, $\mu_{I,E}(\mu_{C,D}\otimes1)=\mu_{C,D\cap E}(1\otimes\mu_{D,E})$ for every third closed $E$, and $\mu_{D,C}\sigma=\mu_{C,D}$ after the support-interchange identification. For $D'=X'\times_XD$, $I'=X'\times_XI$, the canonical tensor comparison gives
$$b_{v,I}\circ v^{-1}\mu_{C,D}=\mu_{C',D'}\circ(b_{v,C}\otimes b_{v,D}).$$
The same equalities hold for the displayed derived tensors. No finite-type, separatedness, reducedness, or Cartier hypothesis is imposed.
